episodes.title: Hello It's Me
episodes.summary: After discussing how to handle change, Carrie is challenged to be "sexually" open on Che's podcast, Miranda has a disastrous first day of school, and Charlotte tries to impress a fellow mom. And then – another big change no one saw coming.

episodes.title: Little Black Dress
episodes.summary: Miranda and Charlotte come to Carrie's aid, proving what good friends are for. Anthony and Stanford vow to let go of petty arguments.

episodes.title: When in Rome...
episodes.summary: Carrie learns of a surprising development involving Big's ex. Charlotte worries about how to handle a daughter's revelation. Miranda ponders the state of her marriage.

episodes.title: Some of My Best Friends
episodes.summary: Looking to move forward, Carrie meets with self-made real estate broker Seema Patel. Meanwhile, Charlotte plans a high-stakes dinner party for LTW as Miranda and Nya connect over the frank realities of motherhood.

episodes.title: Tragically Hip
episodes.summary: As Carrie recuperates from hip surgery, Charlotte learns surprising news about her daughter, and Che's words help Miranda face some truths about her life.

episodes.title: Diwali
episodes.summary: Carrie's giant leap for her future self helps her embrace the past, while Miranda makes a confession to a shocked Charlotte.

episodes.title: Sex and the Widow
episodes.summary: Carrie's publisher tasks her with injecting some hope into her new book, Miranda attempts to rekindle a spark with Steve, and Charlotte bristles when Harry imposes on her sacred space… tennis.

episodes.title: Bewitched, Bothered and Bewildered
episodes.summary: After coming clean to Che, Miranda is spurred toward making a life-altering decision. Carrie attempts to learn more about her mysterious 20-something neighbor. Charlotte's efforts to be more open with her kids about sex get derailed.

episodes.title: No Strings Attached
episodes.summary: Carrie questions whether she's ready to take another step toward letting go. Charlotte boasts that she's finally finished menopause. Miranda's spontaneity backfires.

episodes.title: Seeing the Light
episodes.summary: Charlotte plans the ultimate rite of passage for Rock. Che throws Miranda for a loop. Carrie finds closure.

episodes.title: Met Cute
episodes.summary: Miranda starts to worry that her relationship with Che is only about sex while Carrie wonders if she's ready for more than a casual fling.

episodes.title: The Real Deal
episodes.summary: Carrie struggles with a podcast ad script; Charlotte tries to retrieve Lily's designer clothes; chaos ensues when Miranda loses her phone.

episodes.title: Chapter Three
episodes.summary: Carrie conjures a excuse to get out of an emotional audiobook taping; Charlotte and Lisa try to get their hands on a "MILF" list.

episodes.title: Alive!
episodes.summary: Carrie attends a former mentor's party, where she meets a longtime personal hero. Miranda gets a charley horse.

episodes.title: Trick or Treat
episodes.summary: Carrie runs into a tech entrepreneur. Miranda and Che struggle with different daily rhythms. Charlotte is approaching showbiz mom territory.

episodes.title: Bomb Cyclone
episodes.summary: Carrie asks Che to be her moral support at a conference for widows. Miranda broaches an uncomfortable conversation with Steve.

episodes.title: February 14th
episodes.summary: Carrie ponders the significance of her upcoming dinner with Aidan; a newly single Miranda explores the possibilities of dating again.

episodes.title: A Hundred Years Ago
episodes.summary: Carrie and Aidan play house. Miranda and Charlotte get back to work.

episodes.title: There Goes the Neighbourhood
episodes.summary: Carrie finally decides to let go of her apartment and Charlotte and Miranda are trying to figure out if their kids are starting a relationship with each other.

episodes.title: The Last Supper Part One: Appetizer
episodes.summary: Carrie preps for a dinner party farewell to her apartment – and both its good and bad memories. Miranda takes steps to make amends with her exes.

episodes.title: The Last Supper Part Two: Entrée
episodes.summary: As Carrie puts the finishing touches on her dinner party, Miranda reconnects with Steve, and Seema worries that she's been too vulnerable with Ravi.

episodes.title: Outlook Good
episodes.summary: As Carrie navigates long-distance with Aidan, Miranda considers ghosting a hookup, and Charlotte tries to redeem Mr. Burton.

episodes.title: The Rat Race
episodes.summary: Carrie tries to interpret Aidan's texting style. Seema reluctantly agrees to see a matchmaker. Charlotte and LTW stalk a college prep consultant.

episodes.title: Carrie Golightly
episodes.summary: While Seema tags along on Carrie's trip to Virginia, Charlotte is caught between work and mom duties, and Miranda gets advice from her crush.

episodes.title: Apples to Apples
episodes.summary: Aidan suggests Carrie spend some quality time with his sons after she extends her trip. Later, Miranda takes Joy's advice during an interview.

episodes.title: Under the Table
episodes.summary: While Carrie and Miranda deal with noisy neighbor situations, Charlotte and LTW take their families on a glamping trip to Governors Island.

episodes.title: Silent Mode
episodes.summary: As Miranda takes a tentative next step with Joy, Carrie connects with Duncan on their writing projects, and LTW butts heads with Lucille.

episodes.title: They Wanna Have Fun
episodes.summary: While Carrie plans a fabulous birthday party to boost Charlotte's spirits, Anthony navigates an awkward introduction to Giuseppe's mother, Gia. Later, Charlotte discovers Harry's been keeping a secret, and Seema's flirtation with Adam blossoms.

episodes.title: Happily Ever After
episodes.summary: Carrie attempts to work on notes with Duncan while Aidan is in town for a visit; Seema learns of a potential deal-breaker with Adam; Miranda contemplates whether she can leave her worst chapter in the past.

episodes.title: Present Tense
episodes.summary: As Carrie confronts lingering trust issues in her relationship, Miranda opens up to Joy about her own baggage. Meanwhile, Anthony continues his attempts to win over Gia, and Adam convinces Seema to try something new.

episodes.title: Better Than Sex
episodes.summary: Carrie has a burst of creative energy and receives glowing feedback from Duncan. Brady drops a bombshell on Miranda and Steve, Anthony meets Giuseppe's eccentric roommate and LTW struggles with the demands of work, home and a visit from her mother-in-law.

episodes.title: Forget About the Boy
episodes.summary: Carrie contemplates the ending of her book ... and her own story. Charlotte navigates complicated feelings around Rock's school musical.

episodes.title: Party of One
episodes.summary: As Carrie decides to work on accepting her next phase, Miranda hosts Thanksgiving for the first time in her new apartment.
